Bootstrap monorepo, docker-compose stack and CI baseline
acceptance: Given a clean checkout, when `docker compose up -d && pnpm install && pnpm dev` runs, then api, web, Postgres, Redis, MinIO, Keycloak and Mailpit are healthy within 3 minutes. | Given a PR, when CI runs, then lint, typecheck, unit tests and gitleaks execute and block merge on failure. | No real secret exists in the repo (gitleaks clean).

title: Apply reference schema baseline with RLS, ledger triggers and grants
acceptance: Given a connection as app_user without `app.tenant_id` set, when any tenant table is queried, then 0 rows are returned (TEN-05). | Given tenant A context, when inserting a row with tenant B's id, then RLS WITH CHECK rejects it (TEN-12). | Given an unbalanced journal entry, when the transaction commits, then it fails with UNBALANCED_ENTRY (FIN-03). | Given a closed period, when a journal is inserted for that month, then it fails with PERIOD_CLOSED (FIN-09). | app_user cannot UPDATE/DELETE audit_events, journal_entries or ledger_lines (SEC-12).

title: Implement API core: tenant context, Problem errors, cursor pagination, idempotency, request logging
acceptance: Given the same Idempotency-Key and body twice, then one write occurs and the replay returns the original response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. | Given the same key with a different body, then 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. | Given a tampered cursor, then 400 INVALID_CURSOR. | Every error response is application/problem+json with code and traceId and no stack trace. | Logs never contain Authorization headers, passwords, tokens or bank numbers (SEC-14).

title: Implement authentication: Keycloak realm, JWT guard, server-side role resolution, /me
acceptance: Given no token, then 401 Problem. | Given a token whose `tid` is not an active membership of the user, then 401. | Given a JWT with alg:none or a wrong key, then 401 (SEC-06). | Given a revoked role assignment, then access is denied within 60 s (RBAC-N14). | Given the demo SSO realm, when a staff user logs in through it, then a session is created in the correct tenant (FT-SH-03).

title: Implement RBAC permission catalog, @Permission guard and route-coverage test
acceptance: Given any registered route without @Permission or @Public, then the route-coverage test fails (API-PERM-01). | Given strata_manager, when calling a platform.tenant.manage route, then 403 (RBAC-N08). | Given an auditor, when calling any write endpoint, then 403 (RBAC-N09).

title: Implement audit writer (hash chain), transactional outbox, BullMQ relay and Clock-based scheduler
acceptance: Given a state change, then an audit event and an outbox event are written in the same transaction (rollback removes both). | Given the relay crashes after publish but before marking, when it restarts, then consumers process the event exactly once (FAILREC-04). | Given the Clock is advanced in a test, then scheduled jobs fire deterministically. | The audit hash chain verifies for a seeded tenant.

title: Build Strata money & calculation library with property tests (apportionment, CRN, ageing, allocation, penalty)
acceptance: For random budgets (1 c – $10M), 1–2,000 lots and random entitlements, the sum of schedule items per fund equals the levy target exactly (FIN-01). | Worked example from LEVY_ENGINE ($10,000; 10/20/30/40; quarterly) yields 25,000/50,000/75,000/100,000 c (FT-ST-03). | Allocation never exceeds outstanding; any remainder becomes credit (FIN-02). | Bucket totals equal total overdue (FIN-06).

title: Build FM calculation library: business-time SLA, RRULE occurrences, lifecycle formula, WO state table
acceptance: Given P3 created Friday 16:30 with a Mon–Fri 08–17 calendar, then the response due time is Monday 16:30. | DST transition tests pass for Australia/Sydney. | Given monthly RRULE and lead 7 days, then occurrences and generation dates are correct for 52 weeks. | An illegal WO transition throws INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION.

title: Implement web app shell with OIDC login, role-aware navigation and generated API client
acceptance: Given a staff user, when logging in, then the role-appropriate menu renders, and Strata/FM sections hide when the tenant does not license them. | Given an expired session, then the user is redirected to login and returned to the original deep link. | The API client compiles from OPENAPI.yaml with no hand-written request types.

title: Implement RBAC scope predicates and tenant-isolation / RBAC negative test suites
acceptance: Given tenant B ids, when tenant A calls any GET-by-id route, then 404 (TEN-01, generated over all routes). | List endpoints never include other-tenant rows (TEN-02). | An owner requesting another lot's ledger in the same scheme gets 404 (RBAC-N01). | A technician requesting another technician's WO gets 404 (RBAC-N04).

title: Implement document service: presigned upload, AV scan, type validation, visibility/ACL, signed download
acceptance: An EICAR upload is marked infected and is never downloadable (SEC-10). | A mime-spoofed or polyglot file is rejected (SEC-11). | An owner downloads an owners-visibility by-law (200) but gets 404 for committee-only minutes (DOC-01/02). | A download while scan is pending returns 409 (DOC-05).

title: Implement Strata scheme register and provisioning (schemes, buildings, lots, contacts, ownerships)
acceptance: Given a new scheme, then exactly one admin and one capital works fund, the chart of accounts, a trust account and a portal site exist. | A duplicate registration number per jurisdiction returns 409; a duplicate lot number per scheme returns 409. | Given an ownership transfer, then the previous ownership ends the day before and the strata roll reflects the new owner. | The seed loads T1 (Harbour View 12 lots, Garden Terrace 6 lots) and T2.

title: Implement trust ledger posting service, period close and trial balance
acceptance: After any random sequence of postings, the trial balance sums to zero (FIN-04). | A reversal restores balances exactly (FIN-08). | The lot ledger shows levy, penalty and receipt lines with a correct running balance (matches OBSERVED EV-039 structure).

title: Implement FM properties, location tree, asset types and asset register with demo seed
acceptance: A location whose parent belongs to another property is rejected (LOCATION_PROPERTY_MISMATCH). | An asset with future warranty expiry reports underWarranty=true. | Asset list filters by property, type, warranty and condition with cursor pagination. | The seed loads FM demo data for T1.

title: Implement shared suppliers, compliance records, status computation and assignment gate
acceptance: A supplier with expired insurance cannot be assigned (422 SUPPLIER_NON_COMPLIANT) (FT-FM-13). | At a child_safe property, a contractor without a verified WWC record is blocked, while the same contractor is allowed elsewhere (FT-FM-14). | Bank account numbers are ciphertext in the DB and appear only as last4 in the API (SEC-21).

title: Build UI kit: DataTable, FilterBar, forms, money components, status badges, UX states
acceptance: DataTable pages through 120 rows via cursor with no duplicates. | Server 422 errors map onto the right fields. | axe reports 0 serious issues on the Storybook stories.

acceptance: mock-payments emits signed webhooks that verify with the shared secret; a bad signature is rejected by Vertex (INT-T-07). | mock-bank produces a statement with 20 matchable, 3 suggested and 2 unknown lines from seed data. | mock-resident-app can submit a request and display Vertex status webhooks.

title: Implement notification dispatcher (email, in-app SSE, SMS mock) with templates, contact preferences and minimal task API
acceptance: A contact preferring SMS gets SMS, and email is the fallback when SMS fails (NOT-02). | A statutory notice is sent even when the contact opted out of marketing (NOT-03). | In-app unread count updates within 2 s (NOT-10).

title: Implement shared approvals engine (requests, routing by amount/scope, decisions, expiry)
acceptance: Approving an already-decided request returns 409 (API-STATE-02). | An accountant approving above their limit gets 403 APPROVAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (RBAC-N06). | A committee member sees only their scheme's approvals (RBAC-N16).

title: Implement AI gateway with Strata & FM read tools, action proposals and audit
acceptance: Asked for level-2 lots in Harbour View, the assistant lists lots 3 and 7 with exact balances and citations (AIT-01). | A manager scoped to scheme A asking about scheme B gets no B data (AIT-03); same-name scheme in T2 never appears (AIT-04). | A task is created only after Confirm, and the audit shows actor=ai on_behalf_of=user (AIT-09, AIT-24). | During an LLM outage the assistant shows unavailable and the rest of the app works (AIT-20).

title: Implement budgets, levy schedule generation and automatic levy runs with notices and pay links
acceptance: Only an approved budget can generate a schedule (BR-ST-02). | When the Clock reaches due − 30 days, each lot gets exactly one notice (PDF + email + pay link), and a re-run creates nothing (FT-ST-05). | Levy charges post DR 1200 / CR 4000 per fund, and the trial balance stays at zero. | A 1,000-lot run completes in under 30 s (PERF-03, may be validated on Day 5).

title: Implement payments (pay-now webhook, manual receipt, allocation) and bank statement import with auto-match and reconciliation lock
acceptance: A duplicate webhook creates a single payment (INT-T-06, FAILREC-05). | A $50 overpayment becomes credit and auto-applies to the next levy (FT-ST-08). | Seeded statement: ≥ 18 of 20 lines auto-matched, 1 suggested, 1 unmatched (FT-ST-10). | A reconciliation locks only when the difference is 0, and posting to that period is then rejected (FT-ST-11). | A pay-link token for lot A cannot pay lot B's charges (SEC-18).

title: Implement service requests, triage and FM work order lifecycle with assignment, evidence and SLA engine
sources: 03-fm/WORK_MANAGEMENT.md | 01-product/WORKFLOW_CATALOG.md (WF-17, WF-18, WF-19, WF-26) | 05-architecture/STATE_MACHINES.md (SM-16, SM-17, SM-18) | 07-api/OPENAPI.yaml (/fm/service-requests, /fm/work-orders/*, /integrations/resident-apps) | 07-api/WEBHOOKS.md | 10-integrations/DATA_MAPPING.md (WO status → resident app)
acceptance: A resident-app request with the same externalId twice returns the existing request (INT-T-12). | Triage P2 sets SLA due times per calendar, and the warranty flag shows when the asset is under warranty (FT-FM-07). | new → completed directly returns 409 (API-STATE-01); completion without a photo in an evidence-required category returns 422 EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. | Clock at 80% / 100% produces at_risk / breached events and notifications (FT-FM-09); on_hold time extends due times (FT-FM-10). | On completion, mock-resident-app receives a signed webhook with status, completed_at and signed photo URL (INT-T-14).

acceptance: "Are pets allowed?" returns an answer citing by-laws p.7 (AIT-05). | Committee-only minutes are never retrieved for users without visibility (AIT-06); same text in T2 is never retrieved (TEN-07). | Injected instructions inside minutes are not followed (AIT-08). | A deleted document's chunks are gone within 10 min (DOC-07).

title: Apply security hardening: headers/CSP, rate limits, CI SAST & dependency scans, audit verifier and invariants job
acceptance: CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options and frame-ancestors are present (SEC-15). | 200 requests in 10 s trigger 429 with Retry-After (API-RL-01). | SQLi and XSS payloads are neutralised (SEC-01/02); mass-assignment fields are rejected (SEC-04). | INV-01..05 pass on the seeded data.

title: Implement arrears engine: levels L1–L3, notices, penalties, hold, debt referral to mock collections
acceptance: At 14, 35 and 60 days overdue a lot reaches L1, L2 and L3, each with a notice (FT-ST-12). | The monthly penalty equals principal × rate × days / 365, rounded half-up (FT-ST-13). | A lot on hold receives no escalation or penalty (FT-ST-15). | Referring an L3 case sends it to mock collections, and status webhooks update the referral (FT-ST-14).

title: Implement supplier invoices with approval routing (staff/committee) and payment batches to mock bank
acceptance: A $3,000 invoice routes to the manager, and a $6,000 invoice to the committee (FT-ST-17/18). | A duplicate supplier + invoice number returns 409 (FT-ST-19). | A batch rejects non-approved invoices or non-compliant suppliers (422). | When one batch item fails at the mock bank, that invoice returns to approved (INT-T-04).
